artworks.title: John Williams, D.D., Archbishop of York and Lord Keeper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a man in Elizabethan-style attire. He is seated, facing slightly to his left, wearing a dark hat, with curly or wavy hair, a mustache, and a composed expression. He holds a small book. Surrounding him is an ornate circular frame with text around it. Two smaller figures in period clothing stand on either side, and cherubs engage in various activities above him. A prominent coat of arms is displayed within the circular frame, and the lower section contains decorative elements with Latin text.

artworks.title: Georgii Wither (George Wither)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man positioned facing slightly to the side, with his gaze directed at the viewer. He has a neatly trimmed goatee and mustache, along with short, slightly wavy hair. His attire includes a detailed high-collared shirt with an elaborate lace ruff and a spotted, dark-colored coat. He wears a hat with a large brim. In his hand, he holds a book resting atop the hilt of a sword, part of ornate shoulder armor. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with inscriptions, accompanied by cherubic figures at the top corners holding rolling scrolls. The background is intricately designed with scrollwork and text.

artworks.title: Frontispiece to  William Burton, Description of Leicestershire
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an ornate title page from a historical book. It features various symbolic figures, including "Fame" and "Truth" at the top, a central cartouche labeled "RILUCERA," a banner with the title "The Description of Leicester Shire," and additional text about its content and the author, William Burton, Esq. Statuesque figures flank the banner, and below, an intricate map of "Lindley" is surrounded by decorative elements.

artworks.title: George Montaigne, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: This is an engraving showing a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to his right while looking forward. He has distinct facial features with a prominent beard and mustache. His hair is covered by a close-fitting cap. He is wearing a robe with a fur collar, visible beneath an elaborate ruffled collar. The figure holds a small book in his left hand. The portrait is set within an ornately decorated oval frame, featuring swirling designs and text. Above the figure, there is a crest with a crown and crossed croziers. The background behind the oval frame is richly patterned, with text along the edges of the frame, identifying him as George Mountain, a Bishop of London. Below the portrait, there is an inscription detailing his titles and attributes, with the date 1639 noted at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mustapha III, Sultan of Turkey
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing slightly to the left. He is wearing an ornate turban with a jewel and feather, and has a thick mustache and subtle beard. He is dressed in an elaborate cloak over a detailed garment with buttons. Around his neck, there is a lace collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with classical figures and lion heads. The background has intricate linework, and there is text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Abbot George, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest upwards. He is facing forward, slightly turned to his right. The man has a beard and wrinkles around his eyes, with his hair covered by a flat cap. He is wearing a 16th-century robe with a ruffled collar and a cloak with patterns. He holds a small book. The background features an engraved cityscape with buildings and towers along a riverside. The image is framed by an ornate border with Latin text around the portrait.

artworks.title: Abbot George, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man seated and facing forward. His head is slightly turned to his right, looking directly outwards. He has a long, full beard and short hair under a flat black cap; his facial features are marked by a prominent forehead and a serious expression. He is dressed in voluminous garments that appear to be robes, with a white ruff collar and visible long sleeves. In his right hand, he holds a closed book or manuscript. The background is an intricately designed border featuring symbolic imagery and Latin inscriptions, enclosing the figure within a decorative oval frame. The lower part of the image includes some additional scripted text.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrews, Bishop of Ely and Winchester
artworks.description: The detailed portrait depicts a man seated facing slightly to the right. He has a pronounced forehead, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a pointed beard. The man is wearing a hat, ruffled collar, robe with puffed sleeves, and decorative cuffs. He holds a scroll or paper in one hand, with the other hand visible against his clothing. A decorative border with text and scrollwork surrounds the image, and a coat of arms is at the top within the border. The background features an intricate engraving pattern.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrews, Bishop of Ely and Winchester
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, sitting down and turned slightly to the right. He has a serious expression, a mustache, full beard, neatly styled hair under a square cap, and is dressed in traditional clerical attire with a large ruff collar and voluminous sleeves. There is an ornate ribbon design around him with inscriptions indicating his title and name as "Lancel. Andrewes." He holds a small book or paper in his hand. The background is an aged paper texture.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, Second Earl of Arundel and Surrey
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has sharp facial features, a prominent nose, and a mustache. His hair is styled back with loose curls around the sides. He is wearing elaborate clothing typical of nobility, with a high ruffled collar, ornate doublet, and a medal hanging from a ribbon. The background is decorative with an oval frame around the portrait. There are inscriptions in Latin around the image, and below the portrait is a detailed coat of arms along with descriptive text. The border of the image has a slightly textured, antique appearance.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: Engraved portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual faces slightly to the right with a calm expression. They have a mustache and a small beard, shoulder-length hair, and wear a tall hat, high-collared coat, lace ruff, vest with embroidered patterns. One hand is visible on a decorative armrest with an emblem or crest. Elaborate designs and scrollwork surround the figure. The ornate background includes text inscriptions on a border.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a slightly open posture, facing the viewer. He has a thoughtful expression with a trimmed mustache and beard, and medium-length hair under a broad-brimmed hat. He wears historical clothing with an embroidered coat and an ornate ruff around his neck. The man holds a rolled-up piece of paper with one hand. The background features an engraved frame with Latin inscriptions and scrollwork. A coat of arms is depicted above the man's head, framed by swirling designs. Text at the bottom identifies the figure as "Francis Bacon."

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up in an ornate oval frame. He is seated with a solemn expression, facing slightly to his left. He has a distinctive brow, defined cheekbones, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He wears a tall hat with wavy hair visible around the ears. The man is dressed in period-appropriate clothing with a ruffled collar, a patterned doublet, and a fur-edged cloak. He holds a scroll or document, with decorative elements such as a coat of arms and Latin inscriptions on the frame. The background is filled with intricate decorations.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man seated in a forward-facing position, holding a rolled piece of paper in his right hand. He has a mustache and a goatee, with deep-set eyes and curly hair reaching his collar. He wears a tall hat with a wide brim, a ruffled collar, and a velvet robe with intricate patterns on the sleeves. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with scrollwork and a coat of arms at the top, against a textured background with inscriptions below the image.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated, looking forward with a serious expression. He has a pointed beard, long mustache, wavy medium-length hair, and is wearing a high-collared ruff, a detailed robe or coat, and a wide-brimmed hat with an ornamental band. One of his hands is visible, holding a sheet of paper. The background features an oval frame with intricate designs and an emblem or crest at the top, with inscriptions in scroll-like parts of the frame surrounding the figure. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a distinguished face, wearing a large hat with a decorative band. He has a mustache, pointed beard, medium-length curly hair, and is dressed in an elaborate outfit including a doublet with intricate patterns, a fur-trimmed cloak, and a large lace collar. His right hand rests on a scroll. The background features an ornate frame with a coat of arms, Latin script, and an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated from the waist up. He has a moustache, beard, defined eyes, arched eyebrows, wavy shoulder-length hair, and wears a tall hat with a twisted band. He is dressed in a garment with a large ruff, a patterned sleeve, and a fur-lined cloak. He is holding a paper or scroll. The background has an oval frame with Latin text. Above him, within the frame, is a coat of arms with two figures, a shield, and a Latin motto.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a serious-looking man seated and facing forward. He wears a tall, brimmed hat with a decorative band, and a richly detailed garment with a wide ruffled collar. The man has a long, narrow face, a prominent nose, a slightly downturned mouth, and a short goatee beard. His curly hair peeks out from under his hat. He holds a scroll in his right hand and is surrounded by ornate designs, including an emblem with two figures and a shield. The background is densely shaded, with a scroll-like border with text.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man seated with his torso facing slightly to the right. His face is turned toward the front with a long, slender face, prominent cheekbones, a pointed beard, and a mustache. The man has shoulder-length hair, possibly of a lighter shade. He is wearing a tall, rounded hat with a decorative band, a ruff around his neck, a richly adorned doublet, and a fur-lined outer garment. His right hand is resting on a scroll or piece of paper held close to his chest. Surrounding him is an ornate cartouche frame with Latin inscriptions and decorative elements, including coats of arms at the top. The background features fine line engravings.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a man from the waist up. He is seated and facing forward, holding a scroll in his right hand. The man has a mustache and a neatly trimmed beard, along with medium-length hair curling slightly at the ends. He wears a high, dark hat with a slightly upturned brim, and his clothing is ornate with a large ruffled collar, a fur-trimmed cloak, a patterned vest, and a long-sleeved shirt. A decorative frame with Latin inscriptions encloses the portrait, with an emblem at the top center of the frame. The background is lightly textured, and the border frame includes scrollwork and detailed engraving.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of an older man in a stationary position. He has delicate facial features, with a lined face, mustache, and a small pointed beard. He is wearing a large ruff around his neck, a tall narrow-brimmed hat, and a fur-trimmed robe. The man is holding a scroll in his right hand and the background features ornate linework, a crest at the top, and decorative ribbons with inscriptions framing his portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man within an ornate frame. The man is seated, facing forward, with detailed facial features, wavy hair, a hat, and an elaborate collar. He holds a document in his right hand. The background features intricate engravings, Latin inscriptions, and heraldic symbols.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man portrayed from the waist up. He is seated or positioned facing forward with a slight turn to his left. The man has defined facial features with a prominent beard and mustache, and his hair is curly or wavy, extending to just above his shoulders. He is wearing an elaborate garment consisting of a detailed coat adorned with decorative patterns and a high Elizabethan ruff that encircles his neck. He is also wearing a tall, structured hat with a broad brim. In his right hand, he holds a small rectangular object. The background consists of an ornate oval frame with a coat of arms at the top, and there is text inscribed below the image that reads, "The right Hon ble Francis Lo: Verulam, Vifcount St Alban. Mortuus 9 Aprilis, Anno Dni 1626. Aetatis 66."

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of Sir Francis Bacon. He is depicted facing forward with a composed expression. He has medium-length hair styled with waves, a prominent mustache, and a small goatee. Sir Francis Bacon wears a tall hat with a flat top and a plume, along with a dark doublet with intricate patterns, a lace ruff, and a fur-trimmed mantle. He is holding a paper or book in his hands as part of the crest in the border. The background features an oval-shaped frame with text and ornamental patterns.
